arts.ttl: Leicester vs Sheffield United, EFL Championship Preview, Gameweek 18, 2025
arts.sum: The midday showdown at the King Power Stadium this Saturday will pit Leicester City against Sheffield United in a Championship clash with sharp contrasts in form, ambition and urgency. Leicester, likely to dominate possession at home, may look to build patiently and probe Sheffield United ’s defensive frailties with fluid movements and width.
Dan Childs has looked at the full Championship fixture list and provided correct-score predictions for all 12 contests.
